lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Posterior to the gill slits, high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately five horizontal rows. The central row contains the largest local maxima, spaced at roughly equidistant intervals along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid where the circular maxima are located at the nodes of these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels on its dorsal aspect to lower-intensity shadow pixels on its ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a non-uniform distribution of approximately 14 small, high-luminance blobs, with higher density observed towards the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a unique high-frequency distribution of very small white pixel clusters, significantly smaller and more densely packed than the primary flank constellation.
